body: You mean the IGN date? That's not even a guesstimate or speculation, just a placeholder.

subject: If the Island sells well I
author: YabobK34
body: If the Island sells well I guess they might consider making more updates. But if it turns out people aren't willing to pay or to many players have put the game away for good by the time it comes out they might not. If the September date we have seen is true (and CG have told us that they have something coming out in September) those who bought the game on release will have had it for over 1,5 years.... and not all of them are die-hard fans who will pick the game up again after that long just because the Island is released.

subject: Footage of the Island and Matt Webster
author: ZombieTron
body:
Had a quick look at the video in my lunch break, the footage of the Island is cool! 🥵 No clues as to when we will get our hands on it tho, so it could still be a long wait ahead.

The main worrying thing about the Inside Xbox video is part of the interview with Matt Webster where he says that they do not know when they will stop working on Paradise... they may never stop!!!

Does this mean that there will be more DLC after the Island???
